reason: A DSH plugin for unified event notifications, multi-channel message delivery, inbound approvals and conversations, monitoring alerts, and related administration.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的多渠道通知、状态监控、远程审批与会话交互能力。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with unified multi-channel notifications, status monitoring, remote approvals, and session interaction.

capabilities: Sends notifications through configured external and local channels
Receives inbound messages for remote approvals and agent conversations
Provides heartbeat, stall alerts, and notification-based stop actions
Exposes a loopback web administration console for channel and routing management
Stores notification records in an append-only JSONL ledger
